model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.name: core_fct_sellerlabs_sales_daily
model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.description: Daily sales + traffic by brand × marketplace × sku.
model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.raw_code:
-- Core fact: daily sales + traffic by brand × marketplace × sku

with listings_dedup as (
    select
        venue_id,
        asin,
        listing_sku
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__listings') }}
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by venue_id, asin
        order by listing_sku nulls last
    ) = 1
)
select
    t.date,
    v.brand,
    v.marketplace,
    coalesce(l.listing_sku, t.child_asin) as sku,
    t.child_asin as asin,
    sum(coalesce(t.ordered_product_sales, 0)) as sales,
    sum(coalesce(t.units_ordered, 0)) as units,
    sum(coalesce(t.sessions, 0)) as sessions,
    sum(coalesce(t.page_views, 0)) as page_views
from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__amazon_traffic') }} t
inner join {{ ref('transform_sellerlabs__venues_brands') }} v
    on v.venue_id = t.venue_id
left join listings_dedup l
    on l.venue_id = t.venue_id
   and l.asin = t.child_asin
group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.raw_code:
-- Core: Brand Analytics SQP monthly

select
    s.start_date::date as period_start,
    s.end_date::date as period_end,
    v.brand,
    v.marketplace,
    s.asin,
    s.search_query,

model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.name: core_fct_sellerlabs_inventory_snapshot
model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.description: Latest FBA inventory snapshot by brand × marketplace × sku.
model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.raw_code:
-- Core fact: latest FBA inventory snapshot by brand × marketplace × sku

with latest_snap as (
    select max(i.report_date) as as_of
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__fba_inventory_history') }} i
),
traffic_end as (
    select max(t.date) as as_of
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__amazon_traffic') }} t
),
inv as (
    select
        v.brand,
        v.marketplace,
        i.listing_sku as sku,
        i.asin,
        i.afn_fulfillable_quantity as on_hand,
        i.afn_unsellable_quantity as unsellable,
        coalesce(i.afn_inbound_working_quantity, 0)
            + coalesce(i.afn_inbound_shipped_quantity, 0)
            + coalesce(i.afn_inbound_receiving_quantity, 0) as inbound_total,
        i.afn_total_quantity as total_qty,
        i.report_date as inventory_as_of
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__fba_inventory_history') }} i
    inner join {{ ref('transform_sellerlabs__venues_brands') }} v
        on v.venue_id = i.venue_id
    cross join latest_snap s
    where i.report_date = s.as_of
),
listings_dedup as (
    select
        venue_id,
        asin,
        listing_sku
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__listings') }}
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by venue_id, asin
        order by listing_sku nulls last
    ) = 1
),
velocity as (
    select
        v.brand,
        v.marketplace,
        coalesce(l.listing_sku, t.child_asin) as sku,
        sum(coalesce(t.units_ordered, 0)) / 30.0 as avg_daily_units
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__amazon_traffic') }} t
    inner join {{ ref('transform_sellerlabs__venues_brands') }} v
        on v.venue_id = t.venue_id
    left join listings_dedup l
        on l.venue_id = t.venue_id
       and l.asin = t.child_asin
    cross join traffic_end e
    where t.date between dateadd('day', -29, e.as_of) and e.as_of
    group by 1, 2, 3
),
planning as (
    select
        v.brand,
        v.marketplace,
        p.listing_sku as sku,
        p.alert,
        p.recommended_action,
        p.healthy_inventory_level
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__fba_inventory_planning') }} p
    inner join {{ ref('transform_sellerlabs__venues_brands') }} v
        on v.venue_id = p.venue_id
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by p.venue_id, p.listing_sku
        order by p.snapshot_ts desc nulls last
    ) = 1
)
select
    i.brand,
    i.marketplace,
    i.sku,
    i.asin,
    i.inventory_as_of,
    i.on_hand,
    i.unsellable,
    i.inbound_total,
    i.total_qty,
    coalesce(v.avg_daily_units, 0) as avg_daily_units_30d,
    i.on_hand / nullif(v.avg_daily_units, 0) as days_of_cover,
    p.alert,
    p.recommended_action,
    p.healthy_inventory_level,
    coalesce(i.unsellable, 0) > 0 as has_unsellable_qty
from inv i
left join velocity v
    on i.brand = v.brand
   and i.marketplace = v.marketplace
   and i.sku = v.sku
left join planning p
    on i.brand = p.brand
   and i.marketplace = p.marketplace
   and i.sku = p.sku

model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.raw_code:
-- Core: daily orders by brand × marketplace × sku (Seller Labs orders + order_items)

with venues as (
    select venue_id, brand, marketplace
    from {{ ref('transform_sellerlabs__venues_brands') }}
),
items as (
    select
        oi.order_id,
        oi.venue_id,
        oi.listing_sku as sku,
        coalesce(oi.quantity, 0) as units,
        coalesce(oi.price_item, oi.price_all, 0) as item_price

select

inner join venues v on v.venue_id = o.venue_id
inner join items i on i.order_id = o.order_id and i.venue_id = o.venue_id
where coalesce(o.created_ts, o.modified_ts) is not null
  and nullif(trim(i.sku), '') is not null
group by 1, 2, 3, 4

-- BM waterfall daily grain: brand × marketplace × sku
-- Seller Labs sources only: sl_transactions_pivot + product_ad_performance
-- Uses columns already proven in core_fct_sellerlabs_profit_daily.
-- Promo/shipping/deal/coupon/inventory fee splits: 0 until SL pivot columns are confirmed.

with venues as (
    select venue_id, brand, marketplace
    from {{ ref('transform_sellerlabs__venues_brands') }}
),
txn as (
    select
        t.transaction_ts::date as date,
        v.brand,
        v.marketplace,
        t.listing_sku as sku,
        sum(iff(lower(coalesce(t.event_type, '')) = 'order', coalesce(t.product_revenue, 0), 0)) as product_sales,
        sum(iff(lower(coalesce(t.event_type, '')) = 'order', coalesce(t.quantity, 0), 0)) as units_ordered,
        0::float as promo,
        0::float as shipping_credits,
        0::float as deal_fee,
        0::float as coupon_fee,
        sum(iff(lower(coalesce(t.event_type, '')) = 'refund', coalesce(t.product_revenue, 0), 0)) as refund,
        sum(iff(lower(coalesce(t.event_type, '')) = 'order', coalesce(t.selling_fees, 0), 0)) as referral_fees,
        sum(iff(lower(coalesce(t.event_type, '')) = 'order', coalesce(t.fba_fees, 0), 0)) as fba_fees,
        sum(iff(lower(coalesce(t.event_type, '')) = 'order', coalesce(t.cost_of_goods_product, 0), 0)) as cogs,
        0::float as fba_inventory_fee,
        0::float as fba_storage_fee,
        0::float as fba_longterm_storage_fee,
        0::float as amz_carrier_fee,
        0::float as inbound_placement_fee,
        0::float as fee_adjustment,
        0::float as awd_fee,
        sum(coalesce(t.profit, 0)) as profit_sl
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__sl_transactions_pivot') }} t
    inner join venues v on v.venue_id = t.venue_id
    where nullif(trim(t.listing_sku), '') is not null
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
),
ads as (
    select
        a.date,
        v.brand,
        v.marketplace,
        a.listing_sku as sku,
        sum(coalesce(a.cost, 0)) as ad_spend,
        sum(coalesce(a.attributed_sales_7d, 0)) as ad_sales
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__product_ad_performance') }} a
    inner join venues v on v.venue_id = a.venue_id
    where nullif(trim(a.listing_sku), '') is not null
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
),
joined as (
    select
        coalesce(t.date, a.date) as date,
        coalesce(t.brand, a.brand) as brand,
        coalesce(t.marketplace, a.marketplace) as marketplace,
        coalesce(t.sku, a.sku) as sku,
        coalesce(t.product_sales, 0) as product_sales,
        coalesce(t.units_ordered, 0) as units_ordered,
        coalesce(t.promo, 0) as promo,
        coalesce(t.shipping_credits, 0) as shipping_credits,
        coalesce(t.deal_fee, 0) as deal_fee,
        coalesce(t.coupon_fee, 0) as coupon_fee,
        coalesce(t.refund, 0) as refund,
        coalesce(t.referral_fees, 0) as referral_fees,
        coalesce(t.fba_fees, 0) as fba_fees,
        coalesce(t.cogs, 0) as cogs,
        coalesce(a.ad_spend, 0) as ad_spend,
        coalesce(a.ad_sales, 0) as ad_sales,
        coalesce(t.fba_inventory_fee, 0) as fba_inventory_fee,
        coalesce(t.fba_storage_fee, 0) as fba_storage_fee,
        coalesce(t.fba_longterm_storage_fee, 0) as fba_longterm_storage_fee,
        coalesce(t.amz_carrier_fee, 0) as amz_carrier_fee,
        coalesce(t.inbound_placement_fee, 0) as inbound_placement_fee,
        coalesce(t.fee_adjustment, 0) as fee_adjustment,
        coalesce(t.awd_fee, 0) as awd_fee,
        coalesce(t.profit_sl, 0) as profit_sl
    from txn t
    full outer join ads a
        on t.date = a.date
       and t.brand = a.brand
       and t.marketplace = a.marketplace
       and t.sku = a.sku
)
select
    date,
    brand,
    marketplace,
    sku,
    product_sales,
    units_ordered,
    promo,
    shipping_credits,
    deal_fee,
    coupon_fee,
    refund,
    product_sales + promo + shipping_credits + deal_fee + coupon_fee + refund as net_sales,
    referral_fees,
    fba_fees,
    -1 * abs(cogs) as cogs,
    -1 * abs(ad_spend) as total_ppc_spend,
    ad_sales,
    fba_inventory_fee,
    fba_storage_fee,
    fba_longterm_storage_fee,
    amz_carrier_fee,
    inbound_placement_fee,
    fee_adjustment,
    awd_fee,
    profit_sl,
    (product_sales + promo + shipping_credits + deal_fee + coupon_fee + refund)
        + referral_fees
        + fba_fees
        + (-1 * abs(cogs))
        + (-1 * abs(ad_spend)) as cm1,
    (product_sales + promo + shipping_credits + deal_fee + coupon_fee + refund)
        + referral_fees
        + fba_fees
        + (-1 * abs(cogs))
        + (-1 * abs(ad_spend))
        + fba_inventory_fee
        + fee_adjustment
        + inbound_placement_fee as cm
from joined

model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.name: core_fct_sellerlabs_fba_inventory_current
model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.description: Latest current FBA inventory by brand × marketplace × SKU (locations summed).

inventory_as_of.name: inventory_as_of
inventory_as_of.description: Latest Hub report_date for this SKU.

model.encore_analytics.core_fct_sellerla.raw_code:
-- Core: current FBA inventory (Hub fba_inventory, not history)

with latest as (
    select
        venue_id,
        listing_sku,
        max(report_date) as report_date
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__fba_inventory') }}
    group by 1, 2
)
select
    v.brand,
    v.marketplace,
    i.listing_sku as sku,
    max(i.asin) as asin,
    max(i.fnsku) as fnsku,
    i.report_date as inventory_as_of,
    sum(coalesce(i.afn_fulfillable_quantity, 0)) as on_hand,
    sum(coalesce(i.afn_unsellable_quantity, 0)) as unsellable,
    sum(coalesce(i.afn_reserved_quantity, 0)) as reserved,
    sum(coalesce(i.afn_inbound_working_quantity, 0)
        + coalesce(i.afn_inbound_shipped_quantity, 0)
        + coalesce(i.afn_inbound_receiving_quantity, 0)) as inbound_total,
    sum(coalesce(i.afn_total_quantity, 0)) as total_qty,
    sum(coalesce(i.afn_warehouse_quantity, 0)) as warehouse_qty,
    avg(i.cost_of_product) as cost_of_product,
    avg(i.per_unit_volume) as per_unit_volume
from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__fba_inventory') }} i
inner join latest l
    on l.venue_id = i.venue_id
   and l.listing_sku = i.listing_sku
   and l.report_date = i.report_date
inner join {{ ref('transform_sellerlabs__venues_brands') }} v
    on v.venue_id = i.venue_id
group by 1, 2, 3, 6

model.encore_analytics.marts_sellerlabs_.description: BM Report  - brand × day profitability waterfall (SL Hub sources).
model.encore_analytics.marts_sellerlabs_.raw_code:
-- Mart: BM Report brand × day profitability waterfall (PDF Main Sales / Profitability KPIs)

select
    date,
    brand,
    marketplace,
    sum(product_sales) as product_sales,
    sum(units_ordered) as units_ordered,
    sum(promo) as promo,
    sum(shipping_credits) as shipping_credits,
    sum(deal_fee) as deal_fee,
    sum(coupon_fee) as coupon_fee,
    sum(refund) as refund,
    sum(refund) / nullif(sum(product_sales), 0) as refund_pct,
    sum(net_sales) as net_sales,
    sum(net_sales) / nullif(sum(product_sales), 0) as net_sales_pct,
    sum(referral_fees) as referral_fees,
    sum(fba_fees) as fba_fees,
    sum(cogs) as cogs,
    sum(cogs) / nullif(sum(net_sales), 0) as cogs_pct,
    sum(total_ppc_spend) as total_ppc_spend,
    sum(total_ppc_spend) / nullif(sum(net_sales), 0) as tacos,
    sum(cm1) as cm1,
    sum(cm1) / nullif(sum(net_sales), 0) as cm1_pct,
    sum(fba_inventory_fee) as fba_inventory_fee,

model.encore_analytics.marts_sellerlabs_.raw_code:
-- Mart: Sales brand × day (dashboard KPIs / trend)

with sales as (
    select
        date,
        brand,
        marketplace,
        sum(sales) as sales,
        sum(units) as units,
        sum(sessions) as sessions
    from {{ ref('core_fct_sellerlabs_sales_daily') }}
    group by 1, 2, 3
),
ads as (
    select
        date,
        brand,
        marketplace,
        sum(ad_spend) as ppc_spend,
        sum(attributed_sales_7d) as attributed_sales_7d
    from {{ ref('core_fct_sellerlabs_ads_daily') }}
    group by 1, 2, 3
)
select
    s.date,
    s.brand,
    s.marketplace,
    s.sales,
    s.units,
    s.sessions,
    coalesce(a.ppc_spend, 0) as ppc_spend,
    coalesce(a.attributed_sales_7d, 0) as attributed_sales_7d,

model.encore_analytics.transform_sellerl.name: transform_sellerlabs__venues_brands
model.encore_analytics.transform_sellerl.description: Venue → brand + marketplace for all SellerLabs venues (PROD.TRANSFORM).
model.encore_analytics.transform_sellerl.raw_code:
-- All SellerLabs venues with brand + marketplace attributes (no brand filter).
-- Canonicalize brand families so marketplace-specific venue rows share one brand label.

select
    venue_id,
    store_name,
    marketplace_name,
    currency,
    case
        when venue_id between 3 and 5
            or store_name ilike '%rainier%'
            then 'Rainier'
        when venue_id between 6 and 8
            or store_name ilike '%bliss%'
            then 'BlissnBaby'
        when venue_id between 9 and 11
            or store_name ilike '%mindmint%'
            then 'MindMint'
        when venue_id between 12 and 15
            or store_name ilike '%skinnies%'
            then 'Skinnies'
        when venue_id between 16 and 19
            or store_name ilike '%tough%'
            then 'Tough Outfitters'
        when venue_id between 20 and 23
            or store_name ilike '%stretton%'
            then 'Stretton Online'
        when venue_id between 24 and 26
            or store_name ilike '%medcosa%'
            then 'Medcosa'
        else coalesce(nullif(trim(store_name), ''), 'Venue ' || venue_id::varchar)
    end as brand,
    case
        when marketplace_name ilike '%amazon.com%'
            and marketplace_name not ilike '%ca%'

model.encore_analytics.transform_sellerl.raw_code:
-- Explicit Seller Labs listing ↔ Google Sheet SKU Master mapping.
-- match_method: sku | asin | unmapped
-- Sub-Brand / segmentation comes from the sheet Segmentation column.

with listings_dedup as (
    select
        venue_id,
        asin,
        listing_sku,
        title,
        fnsku,
        coalesce(listing_sku, asin) as sku
    from {{ ref('stg_sellerlabs__listings') }}
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by venue_id, coalesce(listing_sku, asin)
        order by title nulls last
    ) = 1
),

sheet_by_sku as (
    select
        trim(sku) as sheet_sku,
        trim(asin) as sheet_asin,
        nullif(trim(segmentation), '') as segmentation,
        nullif(trim(brand), '') as sheet_brand,
        nullif(trim(sub_brand), '') as sheet_sub_brand,
        nullif(trim(seasonality), '') as seasonality,
        nullif(trim(asin_tier), '') as asin_tier,
        nullif(trim(status), '') as sheet_status
    from {{ source('sellerlabs_sku_master', 'google_sheets__sku_master') }}
    where nullif(trim(sku), '') is not null
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by trim(sku)
        order by trim(asin) nulls last
    ) = 1
),

sheet_by_asin as (
    select
        trim(asin) as sheet_asin,
        trim(sku) as sheet_sku,
        nullif(trim(segmentation), '') as segmentation,
        nullif(trim(brand), '') as sheet_brand,
        nullif(trim(sub_brand), '') as sheet_sub_brand,
        nullif(trim(seasonality), '') as seasonality,
        nullif(trim(asin_tier), '') as asin_tier,
        nullif(trim(status), '') as sheet_status
    from {{ source('sellerlabs_sku_master', 'google_sheets__sku_master') }}
    where nullif(trim(asin), '') is not null
      and nullif(trim(segmentation), '') is not null
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by trim(asin)
        order by trim(sku) nulls last
    ) = 1
),

dogs as (
    select distinct
        nullif(trim(sku), '') as dog_sku,
        nullif(trim(asin), '') as dog_asin
    from {{ source('sellerlabs_sku_master', 'google_sheets__dogs_list') }}
    where nullif(trim(sku), '') is not null
       or nullif(trim(asin), '') is not null
)

select
    l.venue_id,
    v.brand,
    v.marketplace,
    v.marketplace_name,
    l.sku as hub_sku,
    l.asin as hub_asin,
    l.fnsku as hub_fnsku,
    l.title as listing_name,
    case
        when sk.sheet_sku is not null then 'sku'
        when sa.sheet_asin is not null then 'asin'
        else 'unmapped'
    end as match_method,
    coalesce(sk.sheet_sku, sa.sheet_sku) as sheet_sku,
    coalesce(sk.sheet_asin, sa.sheet_asin) as sheet_asin,
    coalesce(sk.segmentation, sa.segmentation) as segmentation,
    coalesce(sk.sheet_brand, sa.sheet_brand) as sheet_brand,
    coalesce(sk.sheet_sub_brand, sa.sheet_sub_brand) as sheet_sub_brand,
    coalesce(sk.seasonality, sa.seasonality) as seasonality,
    coalesce(sk.asin_tier, sa.asin_tier) as asin_tier,
    coalesce(sk.sheet_status, sa.sheet_status) as sheet_status,
    coalesce(
        nullif(trim(coalesce(sk.segmentation, sa.segmentation)), ''),
        'Unmapped'
    ) as sub_brand,
    (
        exists (select 1 from dogs d where d.dog_sku is not null and d.dog_sku = l.sku)
        or exists (select 1 from dogs d where d.dog_asin is not null and d.dog_asin = l.asin)
    ) as is_dog
from listings_dedup l
inner join {{ ref('transform_sellerlabs__venues_brands') }} v
    on v.venue_id = l.venue_id
left join sheet_by_sku sk
    on sk.sheet_sku = l.sku
left join sheet_by_asin sa
    on sa.sheet_asin = l.asin
    and sk.sheet_sku is null

-- Hex Sales KPIs read marts_sellerlabs__sales_brand_daily. Those sales/units/sessions
-- must equal core_fct_sellerlabs_sales_daily rolled to date × brand × marketplace.
select
    coalesce(m.date, f.date) as date,
    coalesce(m.brand, f.brand) as brand,
    coalesce(m.marketplace, f.marketplace) as marketplace,
    m.sales as mart_sales,
    f.sales as fct_sales
from {{ ref('marts_sellerlabs__sales_brand_daily') }} m
full outer join (
    select

        brand,
        marketplace,
        sum(sales) as sales,
        sum(units) as units,

    from {{ ref('core_fct_sellerlabs_sales_daily') }}
    group by 1, 2, 3
) f
    on m.date = f.date
   and m.brand = f.brand
   and m.marketplace = f.marketplace
where m.date is null
   or f.date is null
   or abs(coalesce(m.sales, 0) - coalesce(f.sales, 0)) > 0.01
   or abs(coalesce(m.units, 0) - coalesce(f.units, 0)) > 0.01
   or abs(coalesce(m.sessions, 0) - coalesce(f.sessions, 0)) > 0.01

with dbt_models_data as (
      select
          database_name,
          schema_name,
          alias as table_name
      from PROD.elementary.dbt_models
  ),

  dbt_snapshots_data as (
      select
          database_name,
          schema_name,
          alias as table_name
      from PROD.elementary.dbt_snapshots
  ),

  dbt_sources_data as (
      select
          database_name,
          schema_name,
          name as table_name
      from PROD.elementary.dbt_sources
  ),

  dbt_seeds_data as (
      select
          database_name,
          schema_name,
          name as table_name
      from PROD.elementary.dbt_seeds
  ),

  tables_information as (
      select * from dbt_models_data
      union all
      select * from dbt_sources_data
      union all
      select * from dbt_snapshots_data
      union all
      select * from dbt_seeds_data
  ),

  columns_information as (
      
    
    
    
        (
    
    
    select
        upper(table_catalog || '.' || table_schema || '.' || table_name) as full_table_name,
        upper(table_catalog) as database_name,
        upper(table_schema) as schema_name,
        upper(table_name) as table_name,
        upper(column_name) as column_name,
        data_type
    from PROD.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
    where upper(table_schema) = upper('RAW')
    
)
        
            union all
        
    
        (
    
    
    select
        upper(table_catalog || '.' || table_schema || '.' || table_name) as full_table_name,
        upper(table_catalog) as database_name,
        upper(table_schema) as schema_name,
        upper(table_name) as table_name,
        upper(column_name) as column_name,
        data_type
    from PROD.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
    where upper(table_schema) = upper('staging')
    
)
        
            union all
        
    
        (
    
    
    select
        upper(table_catalog || '.' || table_schema || '.' || table_name) as full_table_name,
        upper(table_catalog) as database_name,
        upper(table_schema) as schema_name,
        upper(table_name) as table_name,
        upper(column_name) as column_name,

model.elementary.metrics_anomaly_score.description: This is a view on `data_monitoring_metrics` that runs the same query the anomaly detection tests run to calculate anomaly scores. The purpose of this view is to provide visibility to the results of anomaly detection tests.
model.elementary.metrics_anomaly_score.raw_code:
{{
  config(
    materialized = 'view',
    bind=False
  )
}}

with data_monitoring_metrics as (

    select * from {{ ref('data_monitoring_metrics') }}

),

time_window_aggregation as (

    select
        id,
        full_table_name,
        column_name,
        dimension,
        dimension_value,
        metric_name,
        metric_value,
        source_value,
        bucket_start,
        bucket_end,
        bucket_duration_hours,
        updated_at,
        avg(metric_value) over (partition by metric_name, full_table_name, column_name order by bucket_start asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as training_avg,
        stddev(metric_value) over (partition by metric_name, full_table_name, column_name order by bucket_start asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as training_stddev,
        count(metric_value) over (partition by metric_name, full_table_name, column_name order by bucket_start asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as training_set_size,
        last_value(bucket_end) over (partition by metric_name, full_table_name, column_name order by bucket_start asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) training_end,
        first_value(bucket_end) over (partition by metric_name, full_table_name, column_name order by bucket_start asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as training_start
    from data_monitoring_metrics
    {{ dbt_utils.group_by(12) }}
),

metrics_anomaly_score as (

    select
        id,
        full_table_name,
        column_name,
        dimension,
        dimension_value,
        metric_name,
        case
            when training_stddev is null then null
            when training_stddev = 0 then 0
            else (metric_value - training_avg) / (training_stddev)
        end as anomaly_score,
        metric_value as latest_metric_value,
        bucket_start,
        bucket_end,
        training_avg,
        training_stddev,
        training_start,
        training_end,
        training_set_size,
        max(updated_at) as updated_at
    from time_window_aggregation
        where
            metric_value is not null
            and training_avg is not null
            and bucket_end >= {{ elementary.edr_timeadd('day', '-7', elementary.edr_date_trunc('day', elementary.edr_current_timestamp())) }}
    {{ dbt_utils.group_by(15) }}
    order by bucket_end desc


),

final as (

    select
        id,
        full_table_name,
        column_name,
        dimension,
        dimension_value,
        metric_name,
        anomaly_score,
        latest_metric_value,
        bucket_start,
        bucket_end,
        training_avg,
        training_stddev,
        training_start,
        training_end,
        training_set_size,
        updated_at,
        case
            when abs(anomaly_score) > {{ elementary.get_config_var('anomaly_sensitivity') }} then true
            else false end
        as is_anomaly
    from metrics_anomaly_score
)

snowflake__get_catalog_tables_sql
macro.dbt_snowflake.snowflake__get_catal.macro_sql:
{% macro snowflake__get_catalog_tables_sql(information_schema) -%}
    select
        table_catalog as "table_database",
        table_schema as "table_schema",
        table_name as "table_name",
        case
            when is_dynamic = 'YES' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE' THEN 'DYNAMIC TABLE'
            else table_type
        end as "table_type",
        comment as "table_comment",

        -- note: this is the _role_ that owns the table
        table_owner as "table_owner",

        'Clustering Key' as "stats:clustering_key:label",
        clustering_key as "stats:clustering_key:value",
        'The key used to cluster this table' as "stats:clustering_key:description",
        (clustering_key is not null) as "stats:clustering_key:include",

        'Row Count' as "stats:row_count:label",
        row_count as "stats:row_count:value",
        'An approximate count of rows in this table' as "stats:row_count:description",
        (row_count is not null) as "stats:row_count:include",

        'Approximate Size' as "stats:bytes:label",
        bytes as "stats:bytes:value",
        'Approximate size of the table as reported by Snowflake' as "stats:bytes:description",
        (bytes is not null) as "stats:bytes:include",

        'Last Modified' as "stats:last_modified:label",
        to_varchar(convert_timezone('UTC', last_altered), 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI'||'UTC') as "stats:last_modified:value",
        'The timestamp for last update/change' as "stats:last_modified:description",
        (last_altered is not null and table_type='BASE TABLE') as "stats:last_modified:include"
    from {{ information_schema }}.tables
{%- endmacro %}

macro.dbt_snowflake.snowflake__get_catal.name: snowflake__get_catalog_columns_sql
macro.dbt_snowflake.snowflake__get_catal.macro_sql:
{% macro snowflake__get_catalog_columns_sql(information_schema) -%}
    select
        table_catalog as "table_database",
        table_schema as "table_schema",
        table_name as "table_name",

        column_name as "column_name",
        ordinal_position as "column_index",
        data_type as "column_type",
        comment as "column_comment"
    from {{ information_schema }}.columns
{%- endmacro %}

macro.elementary.redshift__get_columns_f.macro_sql:
{% macro redshift__get_columns_from_information_schema(database_name, schema_name, table_name = none) %}
    select
        upper(table_catalog || '.' || table_schema || '.' || table_name) as full_table_name,
        upper(table_catalog) as database_name,
        upper(table_schema) as schema_name,
        upper(table_name) as table_name,
        upper(column_name) as column_name,
        data_type
    from pg_catalog.svv_columns
    where upper(table_schema) = upper('{{ schema_name }}')
    {% if table_name %}
      and upper(table_name) = upper('{{ table_name }}')
    {% endif %}
{% endmacro %}

macro.elementary.get_columns_snapshot_qu.macro_sql:
{% macro get_columns_snapshot_query(model_relation, full_table_name) %}
    {%- set schema_columns_snapshot_relation = elementary.get_elementary_relation('schema_columns_snapshot') %}
    {%- set known_columns_query %}
        select full_column_name from {{ schema_columns_snapshot_relation }}
        where detected_at = (select max(detected_at) from {{ schema_columns_snapshot_relation }} where lower(full_table_name) = lower('{{ full_table_name }}'))
        and lower(full_table_name) = lower('{{ full_table_name }}')
    {% endset %}

    {%- set known_tables_query %}
        select distinct full_table_name from {{ schema_columns_snapshot_relation }}
        where detected_at = (select max(detected_at) from {{ schema_columns_snapshot_relation }} where lower(full_table_name) = lower('{{ full_table_name }}'))
        and lower(full_table_name) = lower('{{ full_table_name }}')
    {% endset %}

    {% set columns = adapter.get_columns_in_relation(model_relation) %}

    with table_info as (
        select
            {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(full_table_name)) }} as full_table_name,
            {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(model_relation.database)) }} as database_name,
            {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(model_relation.schema)) }} as schema_name,
            {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(model_relation.identifier)) }} as table_name,
            {{ elementary.datetime_now_utc_as_timestamp_column() }} as detected_at
    ),

    columns_info as (
        select
            full_table_name,
            database_name,
            schema_name,
            table_name,
            column_name,
            data_type,
            detected_at
        from table_info
        cross join
            (
                {% for column in columns %}
                    select
                        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(column.name)) }} as column_name,
                        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(elementary.get_normalized_data_type(elementary.get_column_data_type(column)))) }} as data_type
                    {% if not loop.last %}
                        union all
                    {% endif %}
                {% endfor %}
            ) rt
    ),

    columns_snapshot as (
        select
            full_table_name,
            database_name,
            schema_name,
            table_name,
            column_name,
            data_type,
            detected_at,
            case when
                    {{ elementary.full_column_name() }} not in ({{ known_columns_query }})
                    and full_table_name in ({{ known_tables_query }})
                then true
                else false
            end as is_new
        from columns_info
    ),

    columns_snapshot_with_id as (
        select
            {{ elementary.generate_surrogate_key([
              'full_table_name',
              'column_name',
              'data_type',
            ]) }} as column_state_id,
            {{ elementary.full_column_name() }} as full_column_name,
            full_table_name,
            column_name,
            data_type,
            is_new,
            detected_at
        from columns_snapshot
        group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
    )

    select
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('column_state_id') }} as column_state_id,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('full_column_name') }} as full_column_name,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('full_table_name') }} as full_table_name,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('column_name') }} as column_name,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('data_type') }} as data_type,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_bool('is_new') }} as is_new,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_timestamp('detected_at') }} as detected_at
    from columns_snapshot_with_id

{%- endmacro %}

macro.elementary.get_columns_changes_que.name: get_columns_changes_query_generic
macro.elementary.get_columns_changes_que.macro_sql:
{% macro get_columns_changes_query_generic(full_table_name, cur, pre, include_added=True) %}
    {%- set test_execution_id = elementary.get_test_execution_id() %}
    {%- set test_unique_id = elementary.get_test_unique_id() %}

    with cur as (
        {{ cur }}
    ),

    pre as (
        {{ pre }}
    ),

    type_changes as (

        {# Finding the columns that have changed type. #}
        select
            cur.full_table_name,
            'type_changed' as change,
            cur.column_name,
            cur.data_type as data_type,
            pre.data_type as pre_data_type,
            pre.detected_at
        from cur inner join pre
            on (lower(cur.full_table_name) = lower(pre.full_table_name) and lower(cur.column_name) = lower(pre.column_name))
        where pre.data_type IS NOT NULL AND lower(cur.data_type) != lower(pre.data_type)

    ),

    {% if include_added %}
    columns_added as (

        {# This is the columns that have been added. #}
        select
            full_table_name,
            'column_added' as change,
            column_name,
            data_type,
            {{ elementary.null_string() }} as pre_data_type,
            detected_at as detected_at
        from cur
        where is_new = true

    ),
    {% endif %}

    columns_removed as (

        {# This is finding the columns that have been removed. #}
        select
            pre.full_table_name,
            'column_removed' as change,
            pre.column_name as column_name,
            {{ elementary.null_string() }} as data_type,
            pre.data_type as pre_data_type,
            pre.detected_at as detected_at
        from pre left join cur
            on (lower(cur.full_table_name) = lower(pre.full_table_name) and lower(cur.column_name) = lower(pre.column_name))
        where cur.full_table_name is null and cur.column_name is null

    ),

    columns_removed_filter_deleted_tables as (

        {# This is filtering out the columns of tables that have been deleted. #}
        select
            removed.full_table_name,
            removed.change,
            removed.column_name,
            removed.data_type,
            removed.pre_data_type,
            removed.detected_at
        from columns_removed as removed join cur
            on (lower(removed.full_table_name) = lower(cur.full_table_name))

    ),

    all_column_changes as (

        {# Combining the results of the three queries into one table. #}
        select * from type_changes
        union all
        select * from columns_removed_filter_deleted_tables
        {% if include_added %}
        union all
        select * from columns_added
        {% endif %}
    ),

    column_changes_test_results as (

        {# This is the query that is creating the test results table, by formatting a description and adding id + detection time #}
        select
            {{ elementary.generate_surrogate_key([
                'full_table_name',
                'column_name',
                'change',
                'detected_at',
            ]) }} as data_issue_id,
            {{ elementary.datetime_now_utc_as_timestamp_column() }} as detected_at,
            {{ elementary.full_name_split('database_name') }},
            {{ elementary.full_name_split('schema_name') }},
            {{ elementary.full_name_split('table_name') }},
            column_name,
            'schema_change' as test_type,
            change as test_sub_type,
            case
                when change = 'column_added'
                    then 'The column "' || column_name || '" was added'
                when change= 'column_removed'
                    then 'The column "' || column_name || '" was removed'
                when change= 'type_changed'
                    then 'The type of "' || column_name || '" was changed from ' || pre_data_type || ' to ' || data_type
                else NULL
            end as test_results_description
        from all_column_changes
        {{ dbt_utils.group_by(9) }}

    )

        {# Creating a unique id for each row in the table, and adding execution id #}
    select {{ elementary.generate_surrogate_key([
                     'data_issue_id',
                     elementary.const_as_string(test_execution_id)
                ]) }} as id,
        {{ elementary.const_as_string(test_execution_id) }} as test_execution_id,
        {{ elementary.const_as_string(test_unique_id) }} as test_unique_id,
        *
    from column_changes_test_results

{%- endmacro %}

macro.elementary.dimension_monitoring_qu.name: dimension_monitoring_query
macro.elementary.dimension_monitoring_qu.macro_sql:
{% macro dimension_monitoring_query(monitored_table, monitored_table_relation, dimensions, min_bucket_start, max_bucket_end, test_configuration, metric_properties) %}
    {% set metric_name = 'dimension' %}
    {% set full_table_name_str = elementary.edr_quote(elementary.relation_to_full_name(monitored_table_relation)) %}
    {% set dimensions_string = elementary.join_list(dimensions, '; ') %}
    {% set concat_dimensions_sql_expression = elementary.list_concat_with_separator(dimensions, '; ') %}
    {% set timestamp_column = metric_properties.timestamp_column %}
    {%- set data_monitoring_metrics_relation = elementary.get_elementary_relation('data_monitoring_metrics') %}

    with filtered_monitored_table as (
        select *,
        {{ concat_dimensions_sql_expression }} as dimension_value
        from {{ monitored_table }}
        {% if metric_properties.where_expression %}
            where {{ metric_properties.where_expression }}
        {% endif %}
    ),

    {% if timestamp_column %}
        buckets as (
          select
            edr_bucket_start,
            edr_bucket_end,
            1 as joiner
          from ({{ elementary.complete_buckets_cte(metric_properties, min_bucket_start, max_bucket_end) }}) results
          where edr_bucket_start >= {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_timestamp(min_bucket_start) }}
            and edr_bucket_end <= {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_timestamp(max_bucket_end) }}
        ),

        time_filtered_monitored_table as (
            select *,
                   {{ elementary.get_start_bucket_in_data(timestamp_column, min_bucket_start, metric_properties.time_bucket) }} as start_bucket_in_data
            from filtered_monitored_table
            where
                {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_timestamp(timestamp_column) }} >= (select min(edr_bucket_start) from buckets)
                and {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_timestamp(timestamp_column) }} < (select max(edr_bucket_end) from buckets)
        ),

        all_dimension_metrics as (
            select
                bucket_end,
                dimension_value,
                metric_value,
                row_number () over (partition by dimension_value order by bucket_end desc) as row_number
            from {{ data_monitoring_metrics_relation }}
            where full_table_name = {{ full_table_name_str }}
                and metric_name = {{ elementary.edr_quote(metric_name) }}
                and metric_properties = {{ elementary.dict_to_quoted_json(metric_properties) }}
        ),

        training_set_dimensions as (
            select distinct
                dimension_value,
                1 as joiner,
                min(bucket_end) as dimension_min_bucket_end,
                sum(metric_value)
            from all_dimension_metrics
            group by 1,2
            {# Remove outdated dimension values (dimensions with all metrics of 0 in the range of the test time) #}
            having sum(metric_value) > 0
        ),

        {# Create buckets for each previous dimension value #}
        dimensions_buckets as (
            select edr_bucket_start, edr_bucket_end, dimension_value
            from training_set_dimensions left join buckets
                on (buckets.joiner = training_set_dimensions.joiner
                {# This makes sure we don't create empty buckets for dimensions before their first appearance #}
                and edr_bucket_end >= dimension_min_bucket_end)
            where dimension_value is not null
        ),

        {# Calculating the row count for the value of each dimension #}
        row_count_values as (
            select
                edr_bucket_start,
                edr_bucket_end,
                start_bucket_in_data,
                dimension_value,
                case when start_bucket_in_data is null then
                    0
                else {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_float(elementary.row_count()) }} end as row_count_value
            from buckets left join time_filtered_monitored_table on (edr_bucket_start = start_bucket_in_data)
            group by 1,2,3,4
        ),

        {# Merging between the row count and the dimensions buckets #}
        {# This way we make sure that if a dimension has no rows, it will get a metric with value 0 #}
        fill_empty_buckets_row_count_values as (
            select dimensions_buckets.edr_bucket_start,
                   dimensions_buckets.edr_bucket_end,
                   start_bucket_in_data,
                   dimensions_buckets.dimension_value,
                   case when start_bucket_in_data is null then
                       0
                   else row_count_value end as row_count_value
            from dimensions_buckets left join row_count_values
                on (dimensions_buckets.edr_bucket_start = start_bucket_in_data and dimensions_buckets.dimension_value = row_count_values.dimension_value)
        ),

        {# We union so new buckets added in this run will be included (were filtered by the join we did on 'fill_empty_buckets_row_count_values') #}
        union_row_count_values as (
            select distinct *
            from
            (
            select * from row_count_values
              union all
            select * from fill_empty_buckets_row_count_values
            ) as results
        ),

        row_count as (
            select edr_bucket_start,
                   edr_bucket_end,
                   {{ elementary.const_as_string(metric_name) }} as metric_name,
                   {{ elementary.null_string() }} as source_value,
                   row_count_value as metric_value,
                   {{ elementary.const_as_string(dimensions_string) }} as dimension,
                   dimension_value,
                   {{elementary.dict_to_quoted_json(metric_properties) }} as metric_properties
            from union_row_count_values
        ),

        metrics_final as (

        select
            {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(full_table_name_str) }} as full_table_name,
            {{ elementary.null_string() }} as column_name,
            metric_name,
            {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_float('metric_value') }} as metric_value,
            source_value,
            edr_bucket_start as bucket_start,
            edr_bucket_end as bucket_end,
            {{ elementary.timediff("hour", "edr_bucket_start", "edr_bucket_end") }} as bucket_duration_hours,
            dimension,
            dimension_value,
            metric_properties
        from row_count
        where (metric_value is not null and cast(metric_value as {{ elementary.edr_type_int() }}) < {{ elementary.get_config_var('max_int') }}) or
            metric_value is null
        )

    {% else %}

        {# Get all of the dimension anomaly metrics that were created for the test until this run #}
        all_dimension_metrics as (
            select
                bucket_end,
                dimension_value,
                metric_value,
                row_number () over (partition by dimension_value order by bucket_end desc) as row_number
            from {{ data_monitoring_metrics_relation }}
            where full_table_name = {{ full_table_name_str }}
                and metric_name = {{ elementary.edr_quote(metric_name) }}
                and metric_properties = {{ elementary.dict_to_quoted_json(metric_properties) }}
        ),

        training_set_dimensions as (
            select distinct
                dimension_value,
                sum(metric_value)
            from all_dimension_metrics
            group by 1
            {# Remove outdated dimension values (dimensions with all metrics of 0 in the range of the test time) #}
            having sum(metric_value) > 0
        ),

        {# Calculating the row count for the value of each dimension #}
        row_count_values as (
            select
                {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_timestamp(elementary.edr_quote(elementary.run_started_at_as_string())) }} as bucket_end,
                dimension_value,
                {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_float(elementary.row_count()) }} as row_count_value
            from filtered_monitored_table
            group by 1,2
        ),

        {# This way we make sure that if a dimension has no rows, it will get a metric with value 0 #}
        fill_empty_dimensions_row_count_values as (
            select {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_timestamp(elementary.edr_quote(elementary.run_started_at_as_string())) }} as bucket_end,
                   dimension_value,
                   0 as row_count_value
            from training_set_dimensions
            where dimension_value not in (select distinct dimension_value from row_count_values)
        ),

        {# Union between current row count for each dimension, and the "hydrated" metrics of the test until this run #}
        row_count as (
            select * from row_count_values
            union all
            select * from fill_empty_dimensions_row_count_values
        ),

        metrics_final as (
            select
                {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(full_table_name_str) }} as full_table_name,
                {{ elementary.null_string() }} as column_name,
                {{ elementary.const_as_string(metric_name) }} as metric_name,
                {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_float('row_count_value') }} as metric_value,
                {{ elementary.null_string() }} as source_value,
                {{ elementary.null_timestamp() }} as bucket_start,
                bucket_end,
                {{ elementary.null_int() }} as bucket_duration_hours,
                {{ elementary.const_as_string(dimensions_string) }} as dimension,
                dimension_value,
                {{ elementary.dict_to_quoted_json(metric_properties) }} as metric_properties
            from row_count
        )
    {% endif %}

    select
        {{ elementary.generate_surrogate_key([
            'full_table_name',
            'column_name',
            'metric_name',
            'dimension',
            'dimension_value',
            'bucket_end',
            'metric_properties']) }} as id,
        full_table_name,
        column_name,
        metric_name,
        metric_value,
        source_value,
        bucket_start,
        bucket_end,
        bucket_duration_hours,
        {{ elementary.edr_current_timestamp_in_utc() }} as updated_at,
        dimension,
        dimension_value,
        metric_properties
    from metrics_final

{% endmacro %}

macro.elementary.freshness_metric_query.name: freshness_metric_query
macro.elementary.freshness_metric_query.macro_sql:
{% macro freshness_metric_query(metric_properties) %}
    -- get ordered consecutive update timestamps in the source data
    with unique_timestamps as (
        select distinct monitored_table_timestamp_column as timestamp_val
        from partially_time_filtered_monitored_table
        order by 1
    ),

    -- compute freshness for every update as the time difference from the previous update
    consecutive_updates_freshness as (
        select
            timestamp_val as update_timestamp,
            {{ elementary.timediff('second', 'lag(timestamp_val) over (order by timestamp_val)', 'timestamp_val') }} as freshness
        from unique_timestamps
    ),
    time_filtered_consecutive_updates_freshness as (
        select
            *
        from consecutive_updates_freshness
        where update_timestamp >= (select min(edr_bucket_start) from buckets)
    ),
    -- divide the freshness metrics above to buckets
    bucketed_consecutive_updates_freshness as (
        select
            edr_bucket_start, edr_bucket_end, update_timestamp, freshness
        from buckets cross join time_filtered_consecutive_updates_freshness
        where update_timestamp >= edr_bucket_start AND update_timestamp < edr_bucket_end
    ),

    -- we also want to record the freshness at the end of each bucket as an additional point. By this we mean
    -- the time that passed since the last update in the bucket and the end of the bucket.
    bucket_end_freshness as (
        select
            edr_bucket_start,
            edr_bucket_end,
            max(timestamp_val) as update_timestamp,
            {{ elementary.timediff('second', elementary.edr_cast_as_timestamp('max(timestamp_val)'), "least(edr_bucket_end, {})".format(elementary.current_timestamp_column())) }} as freshness
        from buckets cross join unique_timestamps
        where timestamp_val < edr_bucket_end
        group by 1,2
    ),

    -- create a single table with all the freshness values
    bucket_all_freshness_metrics as (
        select * from bucketed_consecutive_updates_freshness
        union all
        select * from bucket_end_freshness
    ),

    -- get all the freshness values, ranked by size (we use partition by and not group by, because we also want to have
    -- the associated timestamp as source value)
    bucket_freshness_ranked as (
        select
            *,
            row_number () over (partition by edr_bucket_end order by freshness is null, freshness desc) as row_number
        from bucket_all_freshness_metrics
    )

    select
        edr_bucket_start,
        edr_bucket_end,
        {{ elementary.const_as_string('freshness') }} as metric_name,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('update_timestamp') }} as source_value,
        freshness as metric_value
    from bucket_freshness_ranked
    where row_number = 1
{% endmacro %}

doc.encore_analytics.__overview__.block_contents:
# encore_analytics

Guide to the **Encore Brands data platform** - how data is ingested, transformed, orchestrated, and served in dashboards.

**Repository:** [github.com/encorebrands/data-platform](https://github.com/encorebrands/data-platform)

This documentation site is generated from the dbt project **`encore_analytics`** in that repo.

---

## What this platform does

Encore Analytics turns **Seller Labs** data (and SKU Master from Google Sheets) into warehouse tables that power the **Seller Labs Production** Hex app.

Brands: Rainier, Tough Outfitters, MindMint, Skinnies, Bliss n' Baby, Stretton Online, Medcosa (typically US / CA / MX).

| Layer | What it does | Where |
|-------|----------------|-------|
| **Sources** | Seller Labs MySQL (same DB as the Seller Labs UI) + SKU Master sheet | Seller Labs; Google Sheets |
| **Ingestion** | DLT loads raw tables into Snowflake | `dlt/sellerlabs/`, `dlt/google_sheets/` → **`PROD.RAW`** |
| **Transformation** | dbt cleans, joins, and builds dims / facts / marts | **`PROD.STAGING` / `TRANSFORM` / `CORE` / `MARTS`** |
| **Orchestration** | Daily Seller Labs + sheets + dbt | Prefect `sellerlabs-daily` |
| **Dashboards** | Stakeholder Gen App (Sales, PPC, BM, …) | Hex **Seller Labs Production** |

**Production rule:** Seller Labs pipelines write and read **`PROD` only** (never `DEV.SELLERLABSDATA` for the Hex app).

```
Seller Labs (MySQL)
Google Sheets (SKU Master)
        │
        ▼
   DLT (incremental)
        │
        ▼
   PROD.RAW
        │
        ▼
   dbt: TRANSFORM → CORE → MARTS
        │
        ▼
   Hex: Seller Labs Production
```

Canonical write-ups in the repo: [`README.md`](https://github.com/encorebrands/data-platform/blob/main/README.md) · [`docs/SELLERLABS_PROD.md`](https://github.com/encorebrands/data-platform/blob/main/docs/SELLERLABS_PROD.md).

---

## 1. Ingestion (DLT)

Ingestion lives under `dlt/` and always lands in **`PROD.RAW`**.

### Seller Labs

- **Source:** Seller Labs MySQL - the same database the Seller Labs product UI reads.
- **Loader:** `python run.py sellerlabs` from `data-platform/dlt`.
- **Behavior:**
 - **Daily / default:** incremental with lookback lag (typically 1-2 days), merge `delete-insert` on the date cursor for dated facts; dimensions `replace`.
 - **Full history:** `--fresh` (date-windowed; run locally - too heavy for Prefect Hobby).
- **Design:** idiomatic dlt `sql_table` + `pyarrow` + `chunk_size`; tables load **sequentially** (Seller Labs MySQL drops connections under concurrency).

### Google Sheets (SKU Master)

- **Source:** SKU Master workbook (brand, COGS, segmentation, ASIN mapping, Dogs list).
- **Loader:** `python run.py sheets sku-master`.
- **Landing:** `PROD.RAW.GOOGLE_SHEETS__SKU_MASTER` (and dogs list when configured).
- Used for **sub_brand**, BM filters, and **SKU Mapping** in Hex - attributes that are not in Seller Labs itself.

### Sources in this docs site

Enabled sources are only:

- **`sellerlabs`** → `PROD.RAW` Seller Labs tables  
- **`sellerlabs_sku_master`** → `PROD.RAW` Google Sheets (`sku_master`, `dogs_list`)  

Legacy Amazon SP/Ads / Junip / Typeform definitions remain in the repo but are **disabled** so they do not appear here or run in production.  

---

## 2. Transformation (dbt · encore_analytics)

dbt project name: **`encore_analytics`**. Profile: **`encore_analytics`** (`dev` / `prod` Snowflake targets).

### Layers (Seller Labs)

| Layer | Schema | Role |
|-------|--------|------|
| Staging | `PROD.STAGING` | Hub passthroughs (`stg_sellerlabs__*`) |
| Transform | `PROD.TRANSFORM` | Brand/SKU map (`transform_sellerlabs__*`) |
| Core | `PROD.CORE` | Dims + facts (`core_dim_sellerlabs_*`, `core_fct_sellerlabs_*`) |
| Marts | `PROD.MARTS` | Dashboard-ready tables (`marts_sellerlabs__*`) |

Typical select for production:

```bash
dbt run  --target prod --select staging.sellerlabs+
dbt test --target prod --select staging.sellerlabs+
```

### How to navigate this docs site for Seller Labs

In the **Project** tab, focus on:

- `models/staging/sellerlabs`
- `models/transform/sellerlabs`
- `models/core/sellerlabs`
- `models/marts/sellerlabs`
- Sources: **`sellerlabs`**, **`sellerlabs_sku_master`**

Use the blue **lineage** control (bottom-right on model pages) to explore upstream/downstream. Prefer filtering the graph to those paths so Amazon SP/Ads noise does not dominate.

---

## 3. Orchestration (Prefect)

Flow: **`sellerlabs-daily`** (Prefect Cloud, Encore workspace).

Daily sequence:

1. DLT Seller Labs (incremental lookback) → `PROD.RAW`
2. DLT Google Sheets SKU Master → `PROD.RAW`
3. `dbt run` / `dbt test` on `staging.sellerlabs+`

Code: `orchestration/flows/sellerlabs_pipeline_flow.py`.  
Seller Labs IP allowlist must include Prefect managed egress IPs (and your laptop IP for local runs). Details: [`orchestration/README.md`](https://github.com/encorebrands/data-platform/blob/main/orchestration/README.md).

---

## 4. Dashboards (Hex)

**App:** Seller Labs Production (Gen App + SQL cells).  
**Reads:** `PROD.MARTS` and `PROD.CORE` only.

| Tab | Primary mart / object |
|-----|------------------------|
| Sales | `marts_sellerlabs__sales_brand_daily`, `marts_sellerlabs__sales_sku_monthly` |
| Profitability | `marts_sellerlabs__profit_*` |
| BM Waterfall | `marts_sellerlabs__bm_brand_waterfall`, ASIN / KPI compare |
| Orders | `marts_sellerlabs__orders_brand_daily` |
| PPC | `marts_sellerlabs__ppc_*` (brand/SKU plus campaign, ad group, placement daily) |
| Keywords | keyword + search term daily; targeting + halo |
| SQP | `marts_sellerlabs__sqp_weekly`, `marts_sellerlabs__sqp_monthly` |
| Inventory | `marts_sellerlabs__inventory_snapshot`; returns + reimbursements |

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
